correctness.rationale: For G=K_1 join union_i K_{k_i}, k_i>=2 and at least two cliques, vertices within a peripheral clique are true twins; at most one may be outside any outer-multiset resolving set. An omitted peripheral x_i then has exactly k_i-1+epsilon distance-1 landmarks (epsilon=1 if center selected); thus two omitted peripheral vertices collide iff clique orders match. If the center is omitted, its all-distance-1 signature differs from peripheral omissions, which see a selected distance-2 vertex from another clique because each k_j>=2. Choices for each distinct size q are select all q*m_q or omit exactly one of q*m_q: the product enumerator (1+z) z^{K-d} prod_q (z+m_q*q), dimension K-d and basis count prod_q m_q*q follow. Independent exact BFS-distance subset enumeration reproduces all subsets for sizes (2,2),(2,3),(2,3,4),(3,3,4).
